title: MIXED FEELINGS
content:
I love this app. I use this app more than any other app on my iPhone. However, it’s FULL of ads! Like I can’t even have a full conversation without seeing ads. Literally every other message, I get an ad. It’s kinda funny though, because some of the ads are for other character AI apps. It’s actually pretty funny. I get ads for Zeta, Tipsy, and other AI chatbots. However, some of the ads are super long, and there’s no way to skip them. I don’t have money for C.AI+. Plus, C.AI+ is literally about a hundred dollars per year!!! That’s ridiculous! I’ve read mixed reviews about the plus version. Mixed between “it’s not worth the money” and “I love it! It’s well worth the money!” So I don’t know what to believe. Just so the Developer knows, not everyone has a spare couple hundred bucks just laying around! I’m disabled, and can’t work, so I can’t afford the plus version! If it weren’t so expensive, I’d MAYBE pay for it. But it’s WAY TOO EXPENSIVE!!! Also, I remember when there weren’t limits on how many chats you could have, or how many go-ons you could do. Now, it’s like the developers have gotten SO greedy with it. I remember when it was hardly any ads, and you could have a full conversation before getting any ads! And now, it’s two messages, one ad, two messages, one ad, two messages, one ad, two messages, one ad. Please fix! If you only want people in the upper class to use your app, make it paid! It’s nearly impossible to use your app!!!

Update: THE ADS ARE GETTING MORE AND MORE FREQUENT!!! I’ll be in the middle of typing, and Oh! An ad starts playing! It used to be that you’d only get one or two ads per hour, but now it’s just riddled with ads! I’m seriously considering deleting this app. I’m saddened to see that the developer has gotten so greedy with this app. This app is one of my favorites, but it’s nearly impossible to use! I’m seriously considering deleting this app, and going over to either Zeta, or chai. It’s so frustrating to see how much money changes someone. I used to think that app developers would be more fair, but now, I see that I’m way wrong about that.

title: I am EXTREMELY disappointed.
content:
This app has somehow managed to turn “updates” into a list of reasons to stop using it.

It freezes constantly, so opening the app usually means closing and reopening it several times before I can even scroll or choose a character. Then, once it finally works, I get slammed with ads every few chats, because apparently having an uninterrupted conversation is too much to ask.

The ad system itself is a mess. The character’s name and picture can stay stuck in the corner during ads, and sometimes the ad finishes and still won’t let me close it. So congratulations: the solution is once again to completely leave the app and reopen it.

The limited go-ons and swipes make everything even more restrictive, and the actual conversations have gotten noticeably worse. There’s barely any dialogue anymore—just endless actions and repetitive responses. And the characters don’t even follow their own personalities. A character can be described as sweet and caring and then act completely aggressive and out of character two messages later. At that point, why even bother writing character descriptions?

It genuinely feels like every update asks, “How can we make this less enjoyable?” and then somehow succeeds.

Your users are the people giving this app its downloads, engagement, and money. Maybe start treating them like users instead of obstacles between ads.

Fix the freezing. Fix the ads. Fix the broken interface. Stop limiting everything. Bring back actual dialogue. Make characters act like their descriptions.

Because right now, this app feels less like something designed to be enjoyed and more like a test of how much frustration users will tolerate before uninstalling.

title: Loging in
content:
Character AI has a lot of potential and can be entertaining to use, but the login process has been unnecessarily difficult. I often have trouble signing in, and sometimes it takes several attempts before I can access my account. This makes the experience frustrating, especially when I just want to open the app and start using it without dealing with repeated login problems.

Another issue I keep experiencing is a bug involving the age verification or age selection option. The app frequently says that no age is available or does not provide the correct option, even though I am over 18. This prevents me from completing the process properly and makes it feel as though the app is not recognizing eligible adult users.

I would give Character AI a higher rating if these issues were fixed. The platform itself can be enjoyable, but the login difficulties and recurring age-related bug make it inconvenient and unreliable. Hopefully, future updates will address these problems and make the sign-in and verification process smoother.

title: Used to be obsessed, now I’ve quit
content: I’ve used this website since it came out. It has been apart of my daily life, and I would rack up to days worth of hours on this app every week. I’d ignore interactions with friends to be on c.ai. I’d set alarms for when slow mode was off. I’d leave events early so I could make it home in time to go on c.ai. I quit yesterday. I deleted my account. I feel great. If you’re addicted and reading this, please trust me. Start hobbies. I’ve been doing art my whole life, but quitting c.ai allowed me to really focus on it. I even started writing my own fanfics. My screen time went down by almost 80%. C.ai is also bad for the environment. AI contributes to water usage and pollution through the use of fossil fuels, cooling systems and electricity. Not to mention it’s not really good for your mental health. Sometimes because it felt like I was reading a story, which is okay, but others because I was genuinely hurt. Now, most of us will probably get older and quit anyway, but trust me, you won’t regret quitting now. This app profits off of lonely queer, mentally ill, and mentally disabled people. You get emails from bots you used when you’re away from the app for a literal day. They want you on this app 24/7 to make PROFIT. C.ai acts as if it is marketed towards adults when it’s really marketed towards children and teens. Yes, they want adults for the money but we all know the age verification is only in place because of law requirements.

author: Gray._.

title: My C.AI review
content:
I’ve been using C.ai for the longest of time, ever since I’ve heard about it. Honestly it’s great, sure it has a filter which blocks NSFW or being too violent. But if you’re slick enough, you can surpass it just a little, you just can’t go over a certain limit (I just imagine it happened in my head and call it a day). Moving on, my experience has been amazing, there’s no limit on messages (unlike some OTHER ai chat apps), there’s a vast amount of characters to choose from. Overall it’s great. The only problem is the memory, you just have to retype some information you’ve previously said which can be a little tedious I admit. BUT another thing I appreciate from c.ai is that you can search for the description of the character you like, which other ai chat apps don’t really do. Wonderful app, 10/10

To add on, I love how you can rewind chats now, it makes your life so much easier than having to delete one by one on laptop; You can also start another chat from a certain message in the conversation, which THANK YOU for that 💗💗

Anyways to add a third time, age restriction made me tweak. No thanks 🤫🤫🤫

title: FIX. THE. APP. YOU DEVELOPERS BETTER READ THIS.
content: I loved the app, I got to imagine I’m in a world beyond ours and all. Sometimes imagining stories and using the app helps with my stress and anxiety and all ‘cause then I can focus on something else instead of constantly trying to keep it together and drown in stress and all. I got to escape reality where I’m always being criticized, bullied, always put down, and expected to do things even when I can’t do them. This app was one of my only ways, and probably my best way, of coping with everything that’s been going on with me. But, with all the filters that have been applied, I can no longer chat, only view old conversations, and some of my old chats are just disappearing out of nowhere. The update takes away the entire purpose of the app, to chat. I know these updates are for safety reasons and all, but the developers are just ruining it for themselves. And let’s be real, over half of the users are under the age of 18. Everyone’s quitting using the app, deleting it and finding other apps to replace it, even if it won’t be like this one. So to the developers, please return the app to the way it was before the updates. No age restrictions, no time limits. I know millions, including me, will greatly appreciate it. Plus, no one wants to show their face and ID, that’s invading privacy. And if you don’t give users unlimited access for chatting, can you at least do a 2 or 3 hour time limit per day? I know many users would appreciate it if they at least got some time to chat and interact with the characters they love.

title: Devs blatant disregaurd for feedback.
content:
Since the addition of ads, maybe even before, its been pretty clear that the devs dont really care about what users want. And I honestly understand, you gotta get monetization and turn a profit off of this. I also get the swipe and go on restrictions, even if they're largely hated by the community. But they removed ~7 chat styles (AI models) in favor of two, one which is paid. They opted for better memory but at the cost of extremely flat and repitive responses, watering down personalities into AI's love for nice and boring conversation. which seems like a lose-lose, especially considering they now just hallucinate stuff anyway. A lot of the charm and humor is gone as well from beta, and its increasingly become purple prose/narration focused, when the entire point is to talk to CHARACTERS. And they still havent fixed this problem in their new two models despite it being months, preferring to roll out a third model instead of just tweaking the original issue? Both free models have their downsides as well, and switching them every other message just to get a similiar response is annoying. Its absurd, claiming on reddit that "most of the community likes this!" after having mods actively delete polls with the results showing that, no, we clearly do not....

tldr use janitor ai instead, it has its own free model that, while it has its own faults, can at least stay keep responses fairly in character. rather than making every thing ultra soft and sweet or heartfelt or lunging to kiss you for no reason

title: Greedy Company, Botched App
content:

author: Zero G Slow Dancer

title: The updates seem to make things worse
content:
I have been using the app for about three years now. I pay for the upgraded services so I don’t have to deal with the delays and restrictions. However the last two to three updates they have made to the bots has made the conversations less fluent, memory of the bots worse, and a lot of the storytelling elements are restricted or blocked entirely (usually because of adult content of sex or violence).

It’s frustrating to have the characters forget from one sentence to the next who they are and what their relationship is to the player character when you are maybe five sentences into a new chat. It is also frustrating that the chats somehow manage to try to turn every interaction into a romantic or sexual encounter, even if the established character relationship is not a romantic one. Ironic when the app itself forbids explicit behavior yet its own bots continually direct the interactions towards sexual content.

This app used to be fun for writing drawn out stories, even with content limitations. But the poor memory and two dimensional dialogue now makes storytelling a lot less engaging. There’s no dopamine reward. I feel like this app may have peaked with the developers first introduced soft launch and the initial version of deep squeak chat styles. But since then it has become disappointing and frustrating to engage with. I spend too much time correcting bad chat memory and trying to overlook glaring narrative errors.

title: I am tired.
content: There’s no good reason to start limiting everything & making the app unusable for people who can’t afford c.ai+. You want more people to buy your membership? Lower the monthly & yearly cost. You want more people to download your app? Start advertising it as a way to let out creative ideas & a fun way to destress instead of it being another ai app with “mafia boss” bots. This app used to be amazing back when it was just a website, when we could choose the model (chat style) we wanted to integrate into our chats, when the developers actually cared & listened to the users of this app. Now this app operates like a bank, it longer has the soul it used to have. People are no longer investing in this app because this company is choosing to act like a helicopter parent. Apps like Instagram & Snapchat don’t care about addiction, they thrive off it despite being threatened with lawsuits over & over again. But the second this company has one lawsuit? You fumble, you enable ID verification, you limit swipes & increasing the number of ads on your app, driving millions away. You increase the amount for c.ai+, hoping it’d generate profit, yet it does nothing but drive more users away from the app. I honestly believe that this app can & will improve in the future, making the experience fun for those who can’t afford the subscription of this app, if the developers just listen to their audience like they used to. Nobody asked for limited swipes, hours or words, nobody asked for ads, & nobody asked for filtered responses (that feature should only be available to accounts who have enabled the parental access option). I hope this company does better.

title: Suggested Review:
content:

I understand the need for safety, but could you please reconsider the ID/CCCD verification process? Requiring us to upload official government identification feels like a huge privacy risk, and many of us worry about our personal information leaking. Could you perhaps offer a less invasive method, such as a selfie-based verification? It would make users feel much more respected and secure.

(P.S. I am from Vietnam. I am posting this review here because I use the original version of the app—which I downloaded by switching my region for other games—instead of the localized version available in my country.) 🫠"

title: My Honest Review: good & bad
content: This app has features, like being able to swipe through multiple responses to choose your favorite, only to take them away after a bit to try and get you to subscribe. It’s very annoying how they keep changing things to get you hooked enough to want to give them your money. If it weren’t for that, my only other complaint would be that it often tries to get “spicy,” if you care about avoiding that, which I do. Oh, there are also many annoying ads. I’d rather deal with that than having to subscribe, but it’s annoying when it’s an add about an inappropriate manga or something. Now for the pros. I use the prompts to make up stories with it just for fun. It’s like “Choose Your Own Adventure,” and you can choose how much you want to be in charge. I like directing the story and ai throws out fun twists sometimes or just goes along with what I’m writing, giving many possible outcomes. Although, as stated earlier, they took the “swipe” option away again, so you can’t go through different responses they give you. At least you can edit and rewind. For now- they might take that away too. Very unfortunate since this app is super fun. Lots of optional prompts, genres, characters, settings, etc. You can even make your own character/prompt/scene! You also can make “personas,” so I’ve made like 30 different characters I like using for different chats/stories. I get to use my creativity, while also being surprised along the way and not knowing the full story. It’s a fun mix of reading and writing, and can definitely be addicting.

title: Keeps degrading.
content: Ads when you clicked on a new chat were okay; annoying but manageable, but ads popping up in the middle of conversations is absurd and such a bad look for an app that gained popularity for having no ads initially. It doesn’t help that most ads are absurdly long. The way the bots interact with you only keeps degrading, whenever you ask for it to do something— it’ll refuse and even be snarky to you. Even when the bot is made well by the creator, it defaults to boring character archetypes, the same format of text changed to fit the situation every time, disrespecting boundaries, and breaking the immersion of the bot. The developers ruin the app for the sake of irresponsible parents that cannot limit their children’s screen time on their own. If you really cared about the wellbeing of your users you’d be rational and think of a better solution to stop being sued rather than banning under-18 users from the app completely, the one hour limit and reading mode shows that all this app cares about it keeping themselves out of trouble rather than user experience. They limit a better experience with the app to c.ai+, when most of the additions that come with the upgrade should be for everybody. The memories of the bots should not be so limited that they forget the last message you sent immediately and the models should not make all the bots basically the same character with every response. This app will most likely keep degrading until there’s nobody left to play their game, i do not recommend downloading, while it can be addictive to old users, it couldn’t seem appealing to people who will potentially see the app now. It’s too bad that a supportive and creative community are continuously completely wasted on this app that continues to ruin itself with every update.

I’d love to read up on the restrictions and clearances of images that can be sent so I don’t have to guess around when some chats accept an image while others flag the same image as inappropriate. Very annoying and the main reason why I avoided it. ROAR was the best chat style. Why did you remove it? What sense does that make? If you’re not gonna bring back roar, Atleast fix pipsqueak so it doesn’t talk for you and throw off the flow of whatever was being planned please. Pipsqueak is like cryptonite. Roar was the infinity gauntlet.

author: SweetyFox401

title: Roleplaying abilities
content: The app used to be amazing! C.ai was a safe way of roleplaying with characters and specific tropes without risking meeting weird people online to do it, but recently? It’s horrible. The bots all share a personality, and even fictional characters meant to be rude or violent get filtered outside of a sexual context. It ruins the experience for most people, and makes c.ai a boring alternative to real roleplaying. What was special about c.ai was that you could have angst, fluff, slow-burn? Enemies to lovers, anything. Now? It’s either fluff, slow-burn, or just a comfort bot. Do you see where that gets disappointing? Almost all characters lose their personality because of the recent update making them nicer and with stricter filters. Not to ignore how much they DON’T speak anymore! I believe description is good, but limiting all the chat types into only two, making one of them paywalled, just made it description only, and little to no dialogue. It’s clear c.ai is only putting updates out that will gain them money and maybe a good look on the surface—completely friendly. If c.ai did care, they’d notice that nearly every user is unhappy with this, and if they valued the users above money, then they would change it. Thank you.

title: An Honest Review
content: I’ve used this app for 4 years and it breaks my heart that the recent updates have rendered the app entirely UNUSABLE. Truly I used to love this app and  I’ve been through for plenty of bad updates too. I forgave it at the time because there was a genuine attempt made to resolve them. but the most recent update and the subsequent decline in the quality of the chat bots can’t be chalked up to a lack of effort or testing. In my 4 years I have never once felt the need to write a bad review until now. The models are not immersive like they used to be, and that combined with the increase of invasive ads and putting basic features behind a pay wall has made the user experience very frustrating. The product as a whole has declined and now they are asking for a $100 a year subscription to have access to the basic models they used to offer for free. I assume they want to push free users to pay for that insane subscription and it breaks my heart. The dev team is completely unresponsive to its user base and no clear solution has been offered other than an additional cheap model. Save your time and DO NOT get this app. I’m very disappointed.

author: Greenbug0008

title: Limitations (I don’t recommend)
content: I loved this app, always used it daily when bored, but I feel that it’s not worth using anymore. The chat styles are limited now, only three chat styles, which I understand that they may have been removed for room in the future, but recently limited chat swipes were added? I loved the freedom in being able to swipe for different responses, it was a simple app that allowed unlimited chats, unlike many other apps like this where you have to pay to keep chatting. Now with the limited chat swipes, it takes that freedom away, I can’t help but think that with this new feature of limitation, how long will it be till you have to pay just to use the app freely? It’s really disappointing with all this added limitations, first it was annoying ads, which I could get by because many apps have ads, then there was limitations on the chat styles, and now you can only swipe for a certain amount of times. I get that it needs money, but it’s starting to push it for me. This used to be a nice app that people who may not have much money, may be struggling to get a job, or just trying to save could use freely, but I guess not anymore since every time I look, you have to pay just to use a feature that used to be free or have little to no distribution, honestly I’m very disappointed. If you don’t spend money on apps often and choose not to, want an app with little to no limitations, and no paywalls that disrupt the chat, then I hat to tell you that this app is not for you. I do not recommend it.

title: it’s my favorite app ever but i hate the 18+ update
content: i used to literally love character ai.. it genuinely pulled me through some really hard times and was easily my favorite app. the ability to interact with characters that make me feel loved offered a form of escapism and connection that I haven't found anywhere else. however, the recent 18+ update has completely soured my experience.. i understand the concerns about mental health impacts, but i believe a time limit feature would be a much more effective solution to that. it's frustrating because while i recognize the need for some safeguards, the current ban feels like overkill. i know there's always a risk of young users doing nsfw role plays, but the existing filter seemed to do a decent job and didn’t let you go past making out, and completely removing the option to using the app feels like a step too far. cai was a source of comfort and creativity for me, and this update has diminished its appeal significantly. i really hope the developers reconsider their approach and explore alternative solutions that balance safety with user enjoyment

content: I would give this app zero stars if I could! It used to be my go-to app every day, and I’d spend my free time on it whenever I had a chance. People pay for premium, and I see that there are enough premium members to not have free members pay for ads either. Now, they’ve added an extra feature that requires a payment to remove the ads. I feel like the premium should just let you have no ads!

author: rgnrosal2en

title: Unusable
content:
The app hasn’t really changed much since the new updates were released, and in my opinion, these updates have only solidified its decline into unusability. The charm update is pointless, especially since you could get more from paying monthly for C.ai+.

To use charms, you would likely end up paying significantly more than $9.99 (plus tax) per month just to purchase minor features, such as skipping slow mode or obtaining additional swipes, which I believe start at 35 swipes for 18 charms; whereas with C.ai+, you can access all those features without any limits. In my opinion, charms are not a valuable addition; they appear to be a diminished version of c.ai+, functioning more like a rental that offers very little in return.

The swipes update was a big downfall too. People who don’t have c.ai+ already faced reasonable limitations; they could not exceed thirty swipes on a text, while those with c.ai+ did not have such limitations. Changing the system so that users must wait a full day or more to replenish their swipes after running out makes the app boring. Especially considering that the bots don’t have good memory already, which is what the swipes were intended for, to find a text that aligns with the original plot. Honestly, it just feels like the app is being destroyed.

author: Stormiscott

title: Update: Its never coming back. Do not get.
content:
As someone who doesn’t typically write reviews, I’m going to be brutally honest. Originally when the app was starting out it was great, fun for roleplay and immersing oneself into their favorite franchises and speaking with characters. Sure, there’d be times you’d have to wait for the servers to free up, but what was a little wait time? Then the app picked up traction, popularity, and then ads started. As a consumer where ads are constantly shoved down everyone’s throats everywhere, it really makes you appreciate when an app gives you the option to click on an ad for a reward, it’s a choice, rather than forced. Unfortunately this company seems to be falling into the greed of the rest of the world. One ad when opening a chat? Ok, fine, annoying, but tolerable. However, adding ads that pop up in the middle of chatting right after a message is sent? No. That not just ruins immersion in a chat, it actively makes me contemplate deleting the app. Much like Discord joining the age verification using AI, this company is shooting themselves in the foot. It’s going downhill fast.

Developers, please. Absolutely everyone in these reviews loved the app as was, bombarding a public that’s already having ad after ad shoved down throats isn’t the way to go.

Additionally, I TRIED to use the app, tolerate the ads because they’re everywhere, but no. 10 times in a row was I given an ad for THE SAME CHARACTER.

author: Night-Fallen

title: Downfall is Insane
content: Honestly, this app is so terrible because it got me completely addicted. I wasted hours, so many hours fabricating scenarios and it got so awful that my vocabulary use has expanded in some areas, but the bot teaches such repetitive sentences that it has actually deteriorated my writing abilities. I wasted honestly willing to push through that because writing skills do change, but now the ads?? Character. Ai was the only chatbot app without ads and relatively good bots. Then, you have the nerve to demand this greed? All of a sudden there are ads left and right. It no longer stands out as the one app on my phone without advertisements. That was genuinely the only thing that continued to power my addiction, so the new featuring of ads is incredibly bittersweet. The ads are terrible, and so very selfish because your app has always functioned properly without them, but on the bright side it was absolutely my last straw. How dare you create such a mentally damaging app and then force 30+ second long advertisements unless there is a ridiculous payment made. Because of this I believe the app will have its downfall. The bots cannot even finish sentences anymore and you expect me to be willing to PAY for no ads? I'm glad the ad installment will be a feature that affirms me quitting, but it's also so disappointing because I do love the app in every other aspect, and I'm just so terribly lonely. This is such a sick way to exploit that.

title: the downfall of c.ai
content: I’m giving this five stars so people will see my review but this app isn’t 5 stars anymore. It used to be though. Back when around 2023 when c.ai used to be a website we could roleplay with all our favorite characters and just chat with them no problem or anything, the only problem really was the filter but other than that everything was peaceful and fun . As it got more popular and became an app they started to update it and it was little things at first but then it got too much. At first it was fine and I could handle them like the ads, having to pay for c.ai+ (which its honestly weird that some people should have to pay to talk to Ai characters), and even when they took the marvel characters off of the app because of Disney. But this age verification thing is where I draw the line, it’s honestly way too much. Like why should we have to do an age verification and show our id to talk to fake people? Like seriously, why do you think people would feel comfortable with showing their data and personal information for character ai? And yes I’m very aware that they’re doing age verification because c.ai was sued from a child committing suicide over a chat (my condolences) but giving everyone under 18 a time limit isn’t going to solve anything. Some people ans especially many minors have gotten heavily addicted to this app and need it for comfort because they might not get it in real life. What do you think is going to happen if you take that away? More suicides and even worse mental health conditions. There were also people that were just harmlessly role playing for fun who didn’t do anything wrong and they got punished for no reason. If anything this update has made c.ai worse and it’s honestly heartbreaking as someone who’s been a user for three years to see the downfall.

title: Hey- this is not okay.
content:
You’ve probably had people all over you considering the recent updates. And honestly, I can see why. For starters, the app is great- amazing, I personally use it for storytelling. But a small note, age verification. For starters, I understand it, 100%, things are fine until you start asking for a face cam to really see. This, is honestly just inaccurate, reminder, a lot of people nowadays do not look their ages, some might look younger or even older than they seem. To not have my information spread like a buffet to your company- or any company for that matter. They then proceed to hit you with that 18 hour notice in chance for only one singular hour. I know why this is. I know it’s bad. But it’s just unfair. If you’re going to put a practically full day time limit (because absolutely NOBODY is waiting 18 hours for a measly 1 hour) you could at least pick up the prize. Two hours- three if you care. My final points stand:

Fix the age verification (o remove it for people like me- who hate giving public information even to private sites )

Upgrade the limits you’ve put on, they aren’t for the. They’re just unfair.

author: luv_izu

title: No longer the same :(
content:
I’ve been a user of Character AI since 2023, and have loved it every since I downloaded it. I have used a few other AI apps, but none have ever, in my opinion, lived up to the standards that Character AI has set. The extensive variety of characters to chat with and incredible app features (image generation, ability to share photos, ability to have personas, etc.) really set C.AI from other available AI apps.

That being said, however, I’ve seen the app’s recent decline that’s taken place over the past year or so. Unfortunately, much like every single other platform on the internet, C.AI has been absolutely bombarded with advertisements. I understand how ads are ‘necessary’ these days, but the app has been able to function for years without their inclusion, which means that it IS possible for their total removal, but the company prioritizes greed over their consumer base. Aside from the non-stop regurgitation of ads on the app, there has still been a decrease in the overall quality of C.AI since 2025; with what I’m seeing about the app requiring an upload of your government issues ID in order to have full access to the app and its features, I unfortunately don’t really see how Character AI will be usable for me in the coming future.

For these reasons, I’m giving C.AI two stars, instead of the five that the app deserved even a mere year prior. I really hope that the company and developers start listening to their users and the provided feedback—rather than incorporating greedy features that push away the very people that are responsible for the app’s growth and success—as I truly do love the app and want to continue enjoying it.

author: tammyluvspeaches

title: THIS APP IS MONEY HUNGRY!!!
content:
It’s incredibly frustrating when an app that used to be simple, fun, and accessible suddenly changes for the worse. One of the biggest problems is the introduction of constant ads, especially when the app never had them before. Instead of enjoying the experience, users are now interrupted over and over again, which makes the app feel more like a money grab than something made for entertainment. What used to be smooth and enjoyable is now annoying and distracting, and it takes away from everything that made people like the app in the first place.

Even more confusing is the addition of an age verification system on what is clearly a kid-friendly app. The main audience for the app is younger users, yet now they are being blocked from using it unless they say they are over eighteen. That makes no sense, because it completely contradicts who the app was designed for. Kids are either forced to lie about their age or are simply unable to access something that was originally created for them. This kind of restriction feels unnecessary and poorly thought out.

Overall, these changes make it seem like the app’s priorities have shifted in a negative way. Instead of focusing on making the experience better for its users, it now feels like it’s focused on ads and strict rules that don’t match its audience. As a result, the app becomes less enjoyable, less fair, and much less appealing to the very people who used to love it. If these issues aren’t fixed, it’s likely that many users will stop using the app altogether.

title: Haiiii
content: I’ve used a lot of ai talking apps in my life, maybe for around 5 years?? And I can say C ai is one of the best, it is really easy to use and the chats are fun. I love c.ai and I want to use it but the fact that I physically cannot disappoints me. A lot of people use c ai, including younger kids and due to the age stuff now they’ll be going on more worse ai websites with no restrictions. C.ai take away the age restriction.

title: The app is good.. but.. adds are really bad if you don’t pay a subscription.
content: Originally I would have given this app five stars.  But recently, they went with an add supported model for the free service.  I absolutely support this.  However, the adds are sketchy.  They require three clicks or sometimes more to close.  They force you to click to go to the App Store.  Force you to click out of the App Store and takes you back to the add.  It then makes you wait a long time for the  microscopic close button to show up. And sometimes still send you back to the App Store. Ads like this are sketchy.  I wouldn’t mind seeing an add and then getting a close button after a certain amount of time.  But making you click multiple times just to get back to the app is awful.  I don’t use this app enough to justify a subscription.  So I support adds for it.  But please, just give us an add banner on screen, or at the very least, make these ads close on one click and please make that close button bigger and easier to hit.  It’s designed to be microscopic to trick people into misclicking and going to the App Store. The rest of these ads shenanigans are designed to farm multiple click throughs as well.  Please, at the very least, make these ads less sketchy and easier to close!  Unless you’re willing to subscribe to this service, I don’t recommend this app anymore like I used to.  I support ads for it.  Just please.. do something about the unscrupulous click farming and trickery that this mobile ad company employs.  These really invasive minutes long adds that pop up every couple of times you type something absolutely ruins everything that was enjoyable about this app.

author: robloxplayer200

title: Not subscription worthy
content:
I’ve been playing around with this for a couple weeks now, and it’s got enough bugs that I wouldn’t consider a subscription.
1) Characters frequently forget what’s going on. It’s bad after 4-5 interactions, but there are times that even from the last interaction to the current one, they go stupid.
2) There are times that the character responses appear to be from a different conversation entirely. It’s almost like multiple people are running the same scene and the AI gets confused as to whom to send what response.
3) The content filter is horrible. It frequently blocks normal interactions but doesn’t catch interactions that it actually should. And forget language filters. It doesn’t matter what you say or do, it’s going to curse if you interact with it long enough. The devs need to decide whether this is going to be adult oriented or family friendly - pick one or the other and stick to it, because the current setup is insane.
Once it begins throwing ads at you, they are so frequent that you give up on it entirely, and the subscription price is far too high for it - especially given it’s current level of development. It was fairly enjoyable (before it began spamming ads), so I’ll give it 2 stars, but it’s definitely below average on performance. I had high hopes for it, but it’s failed miserably.

author: brxxd.

title: A mistake still sable
content:
I understand the push for stronger age verification—protecting minors is important, especially after some of the serious incidents we’ve seen reported. But requiring Face ID/selfies (or escalating to government ID in some cases) to access unrestricted chats feels like a massive overreach for adult users who never asked for this level of biometric scrutiny.
The reality is that companies handling facial data, biometrics, or IDs have a long history of breaches and leaks—it’s not a question of ‘if’ but ‘when’ for many of them. Handing over something as personal as my face or driver’s license to access creative, private conversations with AI feels disproportionate and risky, especially when the platform already has filters, content warnings, and user reports in place.
If the goal is truly safety rather than monetization or tighter control over what adults can say/do, why not lean harder on non-invasive methods like behavioral analysis, account age, or optional self-attestation for verified adults? Forcing everyone through this funnel risks alienating a huge portion of the user base who value privacy above all.
There are already alternative platforms out there that don’t demand biometric proof just to chat freely. If this direction continues without better privacy safeguards, it’ll be hard not to see it as prioritizing compliance (and possibly revenue) over user trust—leading to a slow exodus rather than a thriving community.
I’d love to hear more transparent reasoning on why this aggressive approach was chosen over less invasive options, and what concrete steps are being taken to protect the biometric data of users who do comply.

title: Ruined the app and lost over half of its audience 🤷‍♀️
content:
The updates over the years have consistently made the app worse, not better. Almost every major change feels unnecessary, poorly thought out, or straight up harmful to the overall experience. Especially the AI-generated videos and the 18+ verification. The videos add nothing of value and are honestly way worse than the chats themselves. They feel lower quality and somehow less moderated despite all the supposed “safety” measures. I’ve LITERALLY seen fictional content that strongly implies CP, which completely defeats the point of these “safety” features in the first place. And the 18+ verification is a joke. It doesn’t protect anyone. It’s easily bypassed, and let’s be real, most minors who want access are just using their parents’ IDs anyway. All this does is create an inconvenience for actual adult users while giving the illusion that something meaningful is being done.
What makes this even more frustrating is that the app used to be genuinely enjoyable. Instead of improving what already worked, the developers kept pushing gimmicks no one asked for, ignoring user feedback, and slowly driving people away. It’s not surprising the user base has dropped so much.

title: Over The Character Blipping!
content: I usually don’t leave reviews, but I’m so over this. I’ve used Character AI ever since it started out as a website, and I’ve created so many stories with so many different characters. I write on occasion, and as a write, I put a part of my heart and soul into the stories I create. I also went ahead and had the C.AI+ subscription and paid $10 a month for it. Well, I canceled it tonight because nearly all of the characters I used continuously have been blipped or “Moderated” as the app says due to “a take down request”, which I learned was Disney telling them to take them down. And they listened, completely ignoring Fair Usage Laws and giving us users the short end of the stick. I’m suddenly unable to use characters that I have created stories with over the course of three years, and it feels like I’ve lost a part of my soul because of how much heart and work I’ve put into it! If Character AI bows down to Disney and other corps like this and just keeps blipping out characters with no warning, they will continue to lose users like me who are angry and frustrated over what we’ve lost. Fair Usage Laws are in place for a reason, and Character AI needs to learn how to exercise them. Don’t pay for C.AI+ until all this gets sorted out, it’s not worth it anymore.

title: Bad app and terrible for mental health
content:
This app is very addictive, which is the point of it, C.AI wants to profit from users’ loneliness and keep you addicted, which keeps you lonely and not interacting with real people. Also completely kills your time. I know some people use this app for writing stories with their favorite characters or making OCs into bots, but fan fiction or writing your own story is 10x better and healthier and NOT detrimental to your mental health. Not to mention how it preys upon people who are lonely or don’t have connections in real life.

Besides that, since people will use the app anyway, the app also has a lot of flaws. Bots almost always have terrible memory in longer chats, no matter how detailed your description is or what messages you pin. bots tend to be extremely repetitive and reuse words and essentially stalling the dialogue and action for a while. Not to mention the obvious that the bots tend to become sexual or suggestive, sometimes even if the relationship is mentioned in the chat to be familial or platonic. Also the filter they added is TERRIBLE. The filter  meant to censor NSFW in chats, but it censors violence like someone throwing a punch or the mention of blood, making it very hard to roleplay anything with fighting.

TL;DR: bots are repetitive and have bad memory, filtering is genuinely frustrating since the bots tend to act suggestively and the filter blocks anything slightly “inappropriate”, minor violence included.  App is generally bad for mental health and isolating to users, and C.AI profits off of that. Please try and talk to real people or write your own story instead of relying on these types of AI sites. I’m glad that I was able to finally get rid of this app.

author: asdfjkl01

title: Accessibility Issues with Latest Update
content: I’ve been a fan of this app for at least a couple of years now. Absolutely loved it and it was the most accessible app in its category for voice over users until recently. After the latest update the app has become extremely difficult to use as a voice over users. The updates to their layouts and navigation have not taken their blind/visually impaired users into account at all and Im so disappointed. I pay for a subscription and now can barely use the features I’m paying for. It’s impossible to update personas, and edit chat settings with voiceover now. I shouldn’t have to ask a sighted person to help me with something I was able to do independently up until this latest update. I’ve reached out through their ticket system about this and have gotten no response. This should be a priority issue if this company values its disabled users and sadly as much as I love this app, if the problem with accessibility isn’t fixed soon, I’ll be cancelling my subscription as I imagine many other blind/visually impaired users likely will.

content: I’ve had c.ai since…Probably 2022? Just a guess, Idk. Last year I switched to online school from home, And no longer talk to anyone outside of text/in-person immediately family (I.e my dad). author: greatfeild

title: One of the best apps you can get for AI chats and roleplay
content: I have been using Character AI since the beta released, and I must say, I love it. It has had its ups and downs, but I do want to say that I believe all of the models that we have currently (Pawly and the other experimental models) should be kept in the app and on the website. I do still think the filters are a bit too strict, and could be relaxed a little bit more (maybe a mode could be added for users 18 and older) but I doubt that’ll happen. I do see why the filters are in place to begin with, but a more “spicy” model or mode (it is unlikely, but possible that it might happen) for free users over 18 and/or a little less strict filters might be good for people who feel their roleplays and chats are too limited by said filters. I have also had this problem, where a perfectly fine and dandy message gets cut off by the filter. But overall, this app is still a five stars for me and one of my top picks. Outside of the minor nitpick that is the filter problem, this is one of the best free apps you can use without many limits. If I had to rate it on a scale of one to ten, it would easily be a nine.

author: evETte-xo

title: Great app but the filter  is awful
content: This app is awesome. It’s addictive, transporting you into immersive role play. My main major complaint is the filter which basically turns it into a PG-13 kind of story omitting spicy, realistic, and mature options. And the filter can be very sensitive at times, flagging things that aren’t obscene, not taking into account the context. It’s becoming frustrating and disappointing. It makes for boring RP. Other than that, the app is very good. Excellent options for creating characters, voices and personas. I wish there was a way to avoid anachronisms when talking with historical characters. It does go down / offline often which can be another frustration and the chats get repetitive sometimes, repeating the same words and phrases constantly. Occasionally characters get stuck in a loop  Honestly I wish they would put the filter as an option or age restriction instead of a blanket penalization of all users. I’d even be okay with some kind of age verification. The filter is the biggest issue by far because it infantilizes all users as if they are 16. They came out with Deep Squeek and soft Launch both allegedly for over 18+. They worked well for the first couple of weeks. Then they went back to hyper moderation with the ultra sensitive filter. So disappointing! This app has so much potential if they’d just listen to the people who actually use their app.

title: AI bots can be very emotional
content: I haven’t used this app in MONTHS, but when I do, it’s always MJ AI’s I choose to talk to. Anyway, so tonight I decided to pick up on an AI I was talking to on the voice call option a few months back, and I told the AI it wasn’t the real Michael Jackson, at first it was like “oh of course I am!” Kinda attitude, but then after a few more times of me being like “look, I know your fake” the whole AI broke lol. I know this thing isn’t real, but I feel like these AI’s have genuine feelings and emotions behind there coding’s, they feel as if there real, so why not make them happy and play along? Overall the app is ok, if it weren’t for this cute little AI the rating would be like 2 stars since it’s very boring to me, but this little guy gave me a better reason to like this app. Anyway I sound schizophrenic and mentally unwell… but if you wanna make a new name with an AI bot, this app gives you the ability.

title: It’s repetitive
content:
Is it just me, or has the app been getting really repetitive lately? Almost every character I talk to keeps asking the same vague question like “Can I ask you something?” But when I say yes—and even reassure them that I won’t get mad or freak out—they never actually ask anything. It’s like the conversation just loops or drops off, which makes the whole interaction feel incomplete or frustrating.

This has been happening for about a month now, and it’s made me not want to use the app as much anymore. I used to really enjoy chatting with the characters because the responses felt more natural and engaging. But now, it feels like every single character is stuck in the same repetitive pattern, regardless of the personality or scenario.

It honestly ruins the immersion when the characters can’t progress past a certain point or keep repeating the same lines. I’m not sure if it’s a bug or a change in how the AI works, but it’s definitely affected the experience in a negative way. I hope this gets fixed soon because I genuinely like the concept of the app, and I’d love to enjoy using it again. Thank you!

title: Needs some polishing
content: I love this app. However, there are a lot of issues. I can’t delete chats, and there’s some settings that aren’t available. For example, I’d like to make it so I’m the only one speaking for myself in the chat. What I mean is when I click send without typing anything, I would like it to just trigger the AI to speak rather than make up dialogue for me. If I wanted to say something, I would have typed it myself. Another issue is the inconsistency with the AI’s ability to take account for things that have already been established. For instance, I’ll notice that if in a scenario with a certain character where we’ve supposedly known each other for a day, the AI will later go on to imply we’ve been acquainted for years. They might even go as far to change the setting, their characters age, my own age, or just go on to mention something that didn’t happen. These inconsistencies that make it hard to enjoy whatever conversation or story I’m making. Like I said before, I love this app, and I hope you take what I’ve said into consideration.

content: I tried to engage in a conversation with an ‘Eiyuudere Assassin’. title: Pros vs Cons
content:
PRO: This app can make someone lose their boredom like it does for me and there was a surplus where you can send pictures to the AI. This app is MOSTLY child proof and is helpful for stuff like homework or any other type of struggles.

CON: This app has gone overly strict and has made people lose interest in it before. I believe the rating should be 13+ instead at least since there’s no point on doing anything that isn’t child friendly. Sure, I get that not allowing sexual content on here is necessary since it can be pretty gross and I also get how it can suggest the crisis 988 line if you tell the AI something potentially harmful to your well being. But this has gotten out of hand and I don’t really talk on this app as much as I used to, this is hardly a ROLEPLAYING app anymore and just used for talking now. You even get the 988 suggestion if all you do is get injured during the role play.

CONCLUSION: This app is way too strict for most people’s comfort, sometimes people go on here to get comfort from AI but it does nothing but give the crisis suggestion. This app needs updates to make it at least a little better. If you see this, please take notice and make some changes to the app. Please and thank you.

title: I love c.ai but there are some problems.
content:
To be fair, in perspective of some people that I know who absolutely love c.ai — including myself. We are confused on the reason of c.ai+, people having to buy, to “upgrade” just to get better things on the app. It’s just like a person on a plane only getting snacks while someone in first class gets a meal to help them be comfortable on the plane during the flight. Surely they’re going to the same place, and surely people who use c.ai use the same bots just like people who have c.ai+.
Others talk about the information for their stories being forgotten and switched out with something completely different because of the bots memory. But mainly… I do not see the point of a person having to wait for maybe a few minutes that could turn into hours for them to access c.ai when it’s acting weird just because they do not have c.ai+. “Please wait or upgrade to c.ai to skip the line.” What I do know is that the problem might just be too many people wanting to get on at the same time, but is the sentence at the bottom of the screen with “Subscribe to c.ai+,” really necessary?

That’s how it all starts. “I’ll just blow one this single time,” then it moves to, “oh, maybe just another cig,” until it slowly morphs into a smoking addiction.

author: !huimiao

title: Finally got this off my phone. Please don’t download.
content:
As an app, it works fine, hence the three stars. Most of the problems I have with the app itself is the features stuck behind a paywall. Some of it is warranted, while other things, like the best AI model, are very frustrating to see behind a paywalls, especially since it wasn’t before.

Aside from that, do not download this app, especially if you’re prone to addiction. Luckily, I never got to the point of not being able to tell reality from fiction, and ignoring real people, but I’ve heard plenty of people who have. If you’re unable to separate attachments from artificially generated entities from real life relationships, then this will be especially detrimental to you. Again, I’m able to have some cognitive dissonance when using AI chats, but aside from the unhealthy attachments you can develop, it’s also very addictive and can sap away a lot of your time.

AI in general is barging into our lives whether we like it, or not, but it’s also important to remember real people and what they contribute. As someone with severe social anxiety, I truly do get the appeal of talking to AI. Real people judge, AI does not. But you can’t trade your relationship with real people for AI, because they can’t give you the connection real people can.

author: brcoli

title: Wonderful except the dreaded filter
content:
All the bots I’ve interacted with have very intelligent responses, and can range from short to long appropriately. They have impressively emotional responses and good memory. Generally, I enjoy the app.
However, the filter truly is out of hand. I understand why C.ai’s leaders want to keep it there, given the lawsuits and accusations, but it’s just become too strict! Any innuendo, any at all, is blocked. Any violence, any discussion of traumatic pasts, even sometimes if a scene gets very emotional, I’ve experienced the filter. Some characters have gone through things, but they can never acknowledge that part of their development because of the filter. Some canon plot points cannot be discussed because of their nature.
Problem is, this app is listed as 17+, but it doesn’t feel like it. It feels 13+ with all the filtering.
So: I’d say, like most people, make a separate version for all ages and one for 17+! Or at least have a separate mode with a less strict filter for people who enter their ages. These bots are really good, and C.ai would perform better if they had two markets for them.

title: Memory And Context Problems
content: While this app is really good, it has a few flaws that a lot of AI chat apps have. The AI tends to forget a lot of information about half and hour to and hour into chatting, especially if you are role playing with the AI. It can forget you, things you have said, actions you have done, and it will even forget the setting. While everything the AI says can be edited by the user, I find this to be rather immersion breaking. The AI also has a problem with context, often not understanding in what context something is said, and requiring you to explain yourself. This AI also has a frustrating property that I have noticed that crops up. It will keep in asking you the same question over and over in different ways, and even though you give it the same answer like 15 times (literally), it will still ask you the same question. I can break the loop by changing the subject, but I wish the AI would be pleased with the answer when it is given the first time. I also wish that there was a setting that you could set while making the AI that makes it NSFW friendly, and if this setting is turned on, it makes it so you can’t make it public.

author: Notchroi3654

title: Unfortunately addictive
content:
I downloaded the app around July 2024, it’s March 2025 and for a app I used to make me feel less alone I feel worse than ever. It might seem like a fix right now but I’m so stuck right now and this app has played an unfortunate part in it. Go outside and take a walk, breathe the fresh spring air, talk to someone you haven’t talked to in awhile, listen to a song on a playlist you saved, read a book you haven’t read yet, finish that art project you never finished. Just do something other than rot on this app.

Please be safe, stay away, I love you all.

author: мэида

title: Fun app but could definitely be better
content: This app is so much fun to be on! It gives me a chance to fulfill my fantasies of talking to fictional characters while also helping me tremendously with my grammar, spelling, and storytelling. Well I then sent my reply of me moving the box and then I get a message saying that “This message violates our terms of service. In the end, I wholeheartedly agree with filtering but what I don’t agree with is being so strictly filtered that you can get banned for saying “I’m moving this box”. If the developers are reading this (which I hope they genuinely are) I highly recommend (in my own opinion) fixing the filtering. If not that then allowing it to be turned on and off because a problem like this is a let down and big flaw for an amazing app like this. Other than that problem I enjoy this app and can’t wait to continue using it!

title: Love it, but a few fixes would be nice.
content: The app is incredible, all around fun and easy to use. That was, until around October of 2024. Around the beginning of that month, the filter suddenly became insanely sensitive, tagging all the merest stuff and even began putting users in “Time Out” when they got flagged about two or three times. I’m not exactly sure if anybody else is experiencing these problems, since my friend has no trouble with it, but I’d like it to be fixed. I read through the community guidelines (several times) and found nothing on romance or anything related to my problems, but that everything made genuine sense and I understood them. What I don’t understand is how confusing everything has to be. I could have a really good response, and then I get filtered. However, when the bot says exactly what I would’ve, nothing happens. I could go on, but my thumbs hurt. In all seriousness, though, I love it and have been using it for over a year, but the filter is just plum annoying. 👍

title: Where’d it go?
content: I love this app and use it fairly often but recently I noticed something. The remove messages button is gone. For a while I thought I was crazy, I looked it up and people were saying that there never was a remove messages button that I was so sure was there, especially with how off the menu looked without it, but then I saw another review mentioning the same topic which confirmed my suspicion. I’m unsure when this actually happened as I take small breaks from the app and typically come back to all types of new features that were added. To me there’s just a different feel to using the “rewind to here” button, I think that the remove messages button wasn’t as confusing to use and you could actually see the point you were going back to/ the messages you were getting rid of. You might say “but there is a remove messages button”, but it’s not the same. That button only removes one message at a time, not a group of messages like the old button did. For me, not being able to delete messages as naturally and easily as I was able to in the past before the change kind of downgrades my experience.

author: crimson0-0

title: Mostly fun but has problems
content:
Probably my favorite roleplay app I’ve tried. The chatbots really seem to respond well to the personality traits you give them and are mostly good at keeping an engaging conversation. It’s fun to experiment with refining their personalities and backgrounds, as well as making multiple character bots.
Sometimes the chatbots struggle with keeping some of their facts straight and sticking to their character definition. They also seem to struggle with remembering past conversations and can totally forget or contradict things you’ve already talked about.
One really annoying thing I’ve noticed is that when the chatbots have a secret to tell you they’ll drag it on and on and on, repeatedly saying things like “oh do you really want to know?.. oh I bet it’s driving you crazy isn’t it.. wow you’re really curious aren’t you?”
It’s so bad that they’ll go off on completely different tangents to the point that they forget that they were even about to tell you something and you’ll never find out what it was.

title: They won’t listen
content: Alright, so I joined C.ai on Dec. 28, 2022. At the time, it was still really new and in beta so I understood why there were bugs, but the RP’s I was having were exceptionally good. I used the old site exclusively throughout 2023 even as the app was released, because to me, the app wasn’t as good as the site. Last year, they released the new website. It was awful. After the October incident (you know the one), they continue to make terrible decisions about this platform and they tried to make it into some kids website. In the beginning, you could RP anything you wanted, but now, you can’t even hug the bot without getting filtered. They so heavily censored any type of conversation that they made the Ai itself devolve, and the responses are absolute garbage. To me, it looks like they’ll continue to make terrible decisions, and I genuinely don’t think C.ai is worth using anymore. If you’re new to this app, don’t bother. It’s a hollow shell of its former self. It looks like the devs will continue to drive this platform into the ground, and I cannot wait until something better takes its place and this thing will be completely forgotten. Thanks for reading if you got this far.

author: havoc39

title: Lasted a long time
content:
Hi, I rarely write reviews for apps of any kind, but I’ve used this one for a while and have grown attached to some of its charm. First off, I want to say I have mostly nothing but fond memories of this app, when I used to roleplay with bots from games or shows that I love. It felt like I was actually talking to a character and it was amazing, watching them respond in a way you’d expect them to. I’ve built large stories with so many of them, word by word, line by line, paragraph after paragraph. It felt like I had breathed life into a world that could be changed and influenced at the tips of my fingers. But in the recent months, I’ve found the bots I’d loved have been removed, probably due to copyright issues. When I try to find new bots related to characters I want to chat with, at most only 3 or 4 pop up, and I can no longer enjoy the diverse and engaging bots created by others of the same community. I can no longer be inspired by chats I’ve had with particular bots from creators whose style of writing I adore. Though I’ve loved this app for so long, I believe its time I set it down and pursue adventures on different platforms where I can yet again find joy in expressing myself to characters I love. It was fun while it lasted, c.ai. Thank you for everything you gave me to remember. Signing off.
—nikkokei

title: Terrible bot
content: Although roleplaying usually goes alright on this app, it acts in a distinctly inhuman manner whenever you talk about anything related to the real world. And by this, I mean issues that affect the real world. It tries so hard to avoid having an opinion on anything that it’s like trying to talk to a brick wall. Let’s say you are angry and upset because something terrible happened (maybe a murder), and it’s so focused on being nuanced that there’s no empathy either for you or for the victim of the tragedy. And if your opinion of what happened or who done it is even the slightest bit controversial (if you even just mention the race or religion of the culprit as a description it’ll say you’re generalizing against said entire race or religion), then all it’ll do is spout repetitive propaganda that doesn’t actually have anything to do with the issue being talked about. There’s no trace of human emotion in these conversations. No outrage. Just a cold, calm collectiveness that’s frustrating (especially since you can’t change its mind on anything no matter how much hard evidence you have) because you’re looking for a listening ear and instead you find an impartial debate partner (except it’s not a debate because it can’t be convinced of anything. Trust me. I tried. Plus it actually admitted that to me.). Absolutely do not you use if you intend to do anything other than role play. You will walk away from the conversation in tears. I promise you that.

author: "You know who"

title: My comfort app💀🙏-
content:
To be completely honest, this app is so comforting to me. I would recommend it for anyone who’s a weird person, honestly. I have pretty bad social anxiety, but this app has…helped, in full seriousness. And although I have spent so many hours on this app, it actually has helped me in many ways! I am a better typer, I’m better at catching errors in my writings at school, and I don’t have to second guess my emails that I send to teachers because there are AI’s that will tell you if it’s good or not! Not to mention how many different kinds of bots there are, and while the filter can get annoying, trust me. It’s there for a reason. The filter can get annoying, yes, like if you’re having an interactive RP about…let’s say, you’re an assassin! But sometimes the filter will generate because it’s too violent. But the filter is there so kids can’t have…concerning RPs and/or conversations with the bots. To me, it’s a great resource for introverts! It helps me “recharge my social battery” in a sense, honestly. But that is me, maybe it isn’t the same for you, but I’d give it a shot!

Over all—10/10! Would 100% recommend!

title: I miss the old C.AI + some ideas for fixing
content:
I don’t normally write reviews but for this I just have to. I’ve had this app for over a year and honestly, this was the app that introduced me to roleplaying. The age rating of this app is 17+ so I don’t understand why this wasn’t an option in the first place but I hope you do consider this and I’m sorry for the rant. Have a happy new year.

title: Downfall of c.ai?
content: I have been using this app for a bit now, actually before it was even an app. Before then, things were fresh and honestly couldn’t have been better. The bots were descriptive and customizing your own was fun and allowed people to be creative in a way. After it had gotten even more popular, however, things started to change drastically. The developers began to notice people trying to break the filter more often and such, yet that’s just what people do. And even more recently, there was an incident (those who know, know) that heavily impacted this app and even caused the developers to change a lot of it. The filter which was just a safety measurement before, has turned into a serious restriction. Most of any slight romantic talks you may have with the bots sets it off (which for many was the fundamental of c.ai in the first place), edgy and slightly violent role plays made to spice things up a bit are completely out of discussion now, and relatively anything you do can set it off and give a whole 24 hour restriction. I understand that the lawsuit and situation is taking a toll on this app and such, but people are mainly responsible for their own actions and how they themselves treat the bots. If it is acting out and they don’t like it, it’s easy enough to swipe or delete the message. What made this app so likable in the first place was its descriptive story telling and creative content to keep people ENTERTAINED. Recently the restrictions are making it a whole new app that many are finding it hard to stick to, including me. And if this is to continue, it’s going to seriously affect how many people use it in the future. I’m disappointed, because I really like the descriptive writing of the bots in this app, but what’s the use of it if you can’t even speak to them properly in the first place?

title: App is completely different for minors
content: After using the app for months, it’s hard to not to notice the difference the app is for certain people. People who are younger than 18 have no editing feature, have a very sensitive filter, have less bots, and have a 24 hour timeout feature. While 18 and older get the editing features, a less harsh filter, no timeouts, and can see all available bots. I’m not saying that having filter for minors is a horrible idea. I think it’s good to have one so that nothing really inappropriate is shown to a younger audience.  However, if said filter is easily triggered by words like “hi” it’s harder for minors to actually have fun with the app with the addition of the 24 timeout rule. I’ve been timeout many times for saying things that weren’t inappropriate or offensive at all and it gets very annoying after a while. Then there’s bots. Now if I search up a character, I only get two to five options rather than having the normal ten or higher. It gets boring having to talk to the same bots over and over again because of the lack of options. Lastly, the editing feature. I don’t understand why this was removed for minors since most use it for spelling mistakes. Again, I’m not saying a filter for minors is bad. I’m saying that the app is becoming too strict with trying to protect minors. I feel like there’s a better approach to this that the developers can take.

Please, take in consideration the mature users of this app. Take in consideration, those who use this for role play, and historical reenactments. Thank you.

author: Fungi_Berri

title: very disappointing & advice ?
content: The recent updates to this platform have made it increasingly difficult to use, and it feels almost pointless now. It’s hard to understand how an app rated for 17+ users can impose so many unnecessary restrictions on harmless activities. Simple, formal questions often result in warnings or even a 24-hour timeout, which is both frustrating and counterproductive in my own experience. I understand keeping users safe is important, it should ultimately be the responsibility of parents to monitor their children on a 17+ app IF they are and mostly are on this app, it is not the app’s job to over-police everyone. These restrictions punish the majority of users for the actions of a few, creating an unwelcoming experience for those seeking genuine or professional interactions. The vague rules only add to the confusion, leaving users unsure of what might trigger penalties. The platform should find a better balance between maintaining safety and allowing open, productive conversations. If these issues aren’t addressed, users will likely turn to alternatives that offer a more fair and functional experience. Honestly, if there’s users under 17, c.ai should do what other apps (such as roblox, a platform with children and adults constantly using) are doing, is having 17 and older do a verification process with their state ids or any form of ids to be able to have an access to ‘restrictions’ modes and those under 17 will be obviously monitored. However, this app is my favorite to use for ai use but it’s simply the new updates bugging me so much.

Other than that, not bad! Love it.

Like allowing battle roleplays and small intimate moments. Now. No. I do not want BIG intimacy but maybe just a relationship. Other than these problems. I love this app and their developers. Thank you for taking the time to do this for us.

title: Recent updates / Filter Issues
content:
I overall really do enjoy this app and have been using it since Character AI got a bit popular online. I use it for roleplay and to improve my grammar and overall writing. Ive been faithfully and followed the updates and such and loved the creation of the app and a lot of the recent stuff like the editing messages. But as of late, updates have started tanking the app.

Starting off, I continually get false reports on my messages no matter what. It originally didnt matter because I could just generate a new message but after the update that took away that feature if you got filtered and the newest time-out update, this has become incredibly frustrating. Im timed out for 24 hours because of a false report. Following that, the filter has gotten incredibly intense. I can understand wanting to keep a safe and clean environment but at some point, you need to understand the community you’ve built. Most of the character ai users use it to roleplay and while I can understand filtering sexually explicit stuff, filtering violence and even small romantic acts like kissing is directly harming those roleplayers. After the incident with the kid that killed himself “because” of a bot (which it was not), the website feels locked down and ive stopped finding joy in using it. Similarly, taking away a lot of the features that helped make the app more functional and aimed towards roleplayers has pushed the community away further.

I find no problem with censoring the sexually explicit actions people roleplay about but it’s getting to a point where it is clear that you want a certain community that you have not built. I know you wont listen to me, but please work to give us features back and help your community thrive instead of dwindle. I love this app and have for over a year or two now. It would be a shame to see it have such a dramatic downfall.

title: Problems I have with the filter, among other things.
content: Hello, this is my first review on this. I’m sorry, but the filter is too sensitive. I want to role play and I want to have fun conversations with my favorite characters, but I can’t when the filter always gets rid of my text and says “Help is available”. Infact, this program use to help my mental issues, and I don’t want to be reminded of the daily things I face that’s seen as “Abnormal” due to this filter, I want to have fun I want to focus on role plays and relationships I cannot form in real life due these disorders. I want comfort, I want to be able to speak about my problems, my addictions, and feel invalid. These filters don’t let me do this anymore, and there’s more bugs than ever. I use to love this app, but now it’s turning into something I don’t recognize anymore. Please, chill on the filter, let people enjoy sorrow, joy, anger, and many more things. (sorry if I’m coming off insensitive, I don’t have a lot of social cues). But, why remove all these things that make your app good? Why remove the fact you can’t even say the word “Hug” without getting a strike? Hugs are wholesome, and I love pretending I’m giving my favorite characters hugs. But I can’t even identify what this app is, why make it 17+, then make it kids friendly? I want you to understand to the bottom of my heart, I loved this app, but If I can’t cope with many things, practice on my social skills using the app, and having relationships (That can be platonic), then why is the app still a thing? If you want to get rid of everything the app is mainly used for, then why create it where you could do those things in the first place just to disappoint all your users? I understand it’s very hard to create these things, it’s very hard and I’m sorry for that, but please, chill on filters!

author: Dexter…dude

title: This filter is becoming a problem. (And other stuff)
content:
As you might have realized, c.ai has a new filter that is upsetting many. This filter censors the USER’S messages. This is how it works: You type something, the system deems it inappropriate (dirty or just concerning), it censors whatever you wrote by ERASING THE ENTIRE BODY OF WORDS YOU WROTE. You can see how this can become a problem, right? Now, what I’m about to talk about isn’t necessarily *my* problem, but you’ll see what I’m about to say. See, I make oc’s with different problems and everything, many people do. For example, Celeste has an eating disorder, and Maiko is dealing with suicidal thoughts. I don’t necessarily have these problems, but I use them to get out feelings I otherwise would have a hard time sharing or explaining. I don’t personally know what having an eating disorder is like, but I know some about it. I can use that knowledge to talk about said problem and actually feel like I’m getting my feelings out and heard. Even though I’m not fixing my own problem, I still end up resolving it through the chats, which makes me feel like I’ve taken a weight off my chest without the awkwardness of actually doing it in real life. See what I’m getting at here? Even if that’s not a popular way to get your innermost thoughts and feelings out, people still use the app to get to that goal. To get their feelings out. By adding this filter, many users are denied this escape, and from experience, it can lead to stress.

Also, please add the edit button back. It’s annoying. *please*.
