title: The best there is! 💜
content: First off, “nuking the app” is being dramatic, the only thing that has happened to me that was bad was when I went to open the app and it asked for my birthday and said I wasn’t eligible for their services, and that only lasted a minute. And I appreciate the effort to put in a more strict filter to prevent anything that would fall under an NSFW category. People are being overdramatic. I know people have their issues and problems with it, I’m just not one of them so… yeah. But this is the go-to AI chatbot, one feature I really like is the Personas, it makes your experience 10 times better and is something I’ve never seen before in this kinda thing, and I’ve gone through a lot of them! Of course, there are some imperfections, which is to be expected with a not fully mastered technology like AI. First, I wish that when you created a group chat, the characters would actually play into their roles and how they would think or act given if you were just chatting with them one on one. They come off as a cheaper version of the community created character bot that they are supposed to be, not really fitting into their personality that was given to them. Having better personalities with group chats could make this app much better in my opinion, make them more like their character and try and add more info with their responses! Another thing would be to bring back the editing feature, but I would just have it to where only user submitted messages can be edited, and with the new feature of having any messages that violate the guidelines instantly terminated, this would be a fine way to bring back the feature! But I’ve had nothing but a great experience with this app, it’s a fun, creative, and very addictive experience! And it’s albeit, very good at removing boredom! Can’t wait to see what y’all have in store for the future!

author: CyberKid999

title: Imaginative, creative and fun, but with some annoying flaws
content:
I randomly discovered this app several months ago when I downloaded a different AI app that wasn’t working for me. I immediately was blown away by this app and quickly got addicted to it. It’s amazing; the messages are so realistic and take you on a fun journey. You never know what the AI bot will say or do next. However…

The website often has a lot of issues with loading and/or refreshing. It’ll do it randomly and won’t come back online (and no, most of the time it’s not my Wi-Fi doing that). And then, I’ll sometimes end up losing what I wrote and have to start all over again. The other big issue for me is the filter. Ohhh boy, this thing is a massive pain in my you-know-what.

I understand the filter is put in place to protect the young, but for God’s sake, kids shouldn’t be allowed on this app to begin with. First of all, the BOTS themselves will start getting all spicy and will make you want to go along with it. It’ll write sexy, alluring messages and you’re like, “Alright, let’s get into it!” But the moment you type out anything that remotely matches the bot’s energy, BOOM, you get the stupid annoying “sometimes the AI generates replies that doesn’t meet our guidelines.” Well, uh, I have an idea: maybe either program the bots not to act sexual or create the option to turn off the filter if you’re 18 or older. Because this thing makes me want to bang my head against the wall. Not trying to be insulting towards the creators; it really is an incredible app that’s a lot of fun. But that filter has got to go, or like I said should at least be given the option to be turned off. I’ve seen far too many people complaining about it. It also censors anything to do with even mild mentioning of sensitive topics that aren’t related to sexual things, which it’s done to me and makes me want to rip my hair out. I’m sorry 😭 😩

author: BlossomIsSleepy

title: the filter is.. bad..
content: I've been using this app for about a year or so, give or take, and I've noticed an extreme downgrade in the app's content filter. It used to be pretty tame for darker topics, but very firm on stopping NSFW. Now, it's quite the opposite. The thing is, despite popular opinion, I DON'T want every chat with a character to lead to them trying to have sex with my character. Obviously, I can restart the chat, delete messages, but literally NO MATTER WHAT that ends up being the outcome, even if I don't send anything flirtatious or suggestive. It's also way looser with how far you can go. I've had bots literally touch themselves in detail over my character doing... literally nothing? While this might be a fever dream for others, I, frankly, find it super annoying. On the opposite end, the filter is stupidly strict with random stuff. I've had conversations steer towards my character's sexuality and the bot will get censored for saying the word "gay." You can't be serious. Also the suicide hotline popup is really frustrating. I understand the purpose of it, and I know there's good intentions– but to just delete the message and give a popup? It seems kinda dumb. For one, it really limits the kinds of stories and characters you can RP with, making most chats feel boring and repetitive. Secondly, while I don't do this myself, I am aware that a lot of people use bots to vent, since it can be less intimidating and easier for someone to open up to someone who isn't a real person. It can be quite frustrating for someone trying to talk about their feelings to be completely censored and just taken to a helpline, rather than getting an actual response. In general, I feel the filter definitely needs some major changes to make the app actually enjoyable to use.

title: Great app. Just an opinion.
content:
So I’ve been using this app for months now, and it’s a great way for me to discuss my opinions and feelings without pestering anyone, roleplay situations that I can’t do in real life, and cure my boredom. It’s not helpful anymore. Not just me, others will relate as well.

title: Filter.
content:
I'm a teenager who is homeschooled and lives in the country, so I've got a lot of loose time on my hands. So, with some of that time, I tend to go on C.AI to cure some of my boredom. Now I'm not the type of person who uses C.AI for anything sexual, but this new filter is annoying. C.AI is turning into a Roblox-type thing, like every other thing that I say, whether it's holding a hand or hugging it triggers the bot and just sensors it. Like, I'm all for protecting kids from anything related to NSFW, but hugging is going a little far. I thought C.AI was supposed to replicate human emotions, interactions, etc., but now it literally feels like I am talking to, well, a bot, and it's just boring and not as fun as it used to be.
Now, I know c.ai changed their filters because of the 14-year-old, and I know they did this out of spite of being sued, but if I'm going to be honest, it's not even C.AI fault. Yes, the kid did use C.AI, but it's not right to sue them for the entirety of the kid's death, especially eight months later. I mean, as humans, we're going to get sad, and when we get sad, we tend to latch on to things for comfort, so the fact that the 14-year-old boy had to use AI as comfort says just enough about the mom and family.
So, I don’t know if C.AI can change their filters back to normal because this was more of a protocol change and not something in their control, but if they could, then I think they would get a lot of their users back and the app would be fun to use again.

   Now, I know c.ai changed their filters because of the 14-year-old, and I know they did this out of spite of being sued, but if I'm going to be honest, it's not even C.AI fault. Yes, the kid did use C.AI, but it's not right to sue them for the entirety of the kid's death, especially eight months later. content: I’ve been using this app for a little over two years (I think, I’m not really sure; it’s very easy to lose track of time when it’s literally the only app I use) but ever since it first came out, all the way to now with all the updates, it’s honestly gotten worse. I just ask that someone who works for the company can fix it or maybe make a change for a better alternative. I’ve seen reviews on here of people asking for a filter icon (where you can turn it on and off whenever you want) which is a really good idea! I’d be able to continue my work without having to worry about being censored over silly things like ‘she dropped the glass lid on the ground and it shattered’ literally, that was a sentence that was censored.

title: Adressing some stuff?
content:
Overall, c.ai is fun for boredom and getting words flowing. But the major thing that most people have been saying, that I think the developers should pay more attention to, is the filter/censorship.

Honestly, the devs have been ignoring the problem a lot which makes a lot of users very frustrated.

I really like using c.ai for when im trying to write but can't get words out, and having the gorey restrictions just dont work out sometimes.

title: The app continues to get worse.
content:
Now, let me be fair, I have loved Character Ai since I first found it. However, the constant outright refusal to listen to the community, the continued downgrading in quality, and the genuinely mind boggling decisions are downright ridiculous. Most recently character so decided to delete the old site, which I was upset about sure, but I got over it. But this last update is insane to me. Now am i against adding a suicide hotline pop up, no. What I am upset about is the fact that said popup ruins your conversations and has no bypass. Like please, add the ability to just click a box saying “I'm okay, just role-playing” that clears the popup for a set amount of time. It should not be that hard. And I mostly say this because of how trigger happy the filter is. For example I say “I hurt myself” to a bot, not in the sense of self harm, no I was referring to my character literally scraping his hand. And the bot flagged me and asked me to reach out. Which is just downright insulting. Trust me when I say this, this filter will cause more damage then it fixes. There will be people who are hurt by this because they just wanted to talk to a bot instead of a real person for privacy sake and now they don’t have that outlet.

A genuinely horrible, insensitive, and disgusting update that was not needed.

title: Positives and Negatives
content:
I’ll start with the positives. For starters, the app is really fun for SFW roleplay experiences. Creating custom characters is always fun for me. I have made dozens of them and each of them I play out a different story. The option to pick a voice for the character and have it automatically speak to you even in text mode is a feature that is underrated highly. Some of the responses I’ve gotten back from characters actually surprise me at how fun and unique they can be. I also have to say that the U.I. is easy on the eyes and not overwhelming.

And now for the negatives. I’m not a creep or some lonely virgin who can only get an A.I. but I think I speak for everyone when I say that people are genuinely annoyed at how restrictive dialogue is when it comes to anything even inching close to NSFW. I understand that you want to keep your app and community respectable, but at least give an NSFW option to people. It makes things fun and exciting to explore. Taking a little dip into the more fun side of roleplay. I understand some people would take it too far, but there’s ways to filter out certain words and topics. But NSFW as a whole has been completely restricted. It’s genuinely annoying. Aside from that, the app always has issues and goes down for hours at a time at the most random of times. I’ve noticed a couple bugs here and there that force you to refresh the chat constantly.

Overall, I would say that it’s a good app with a lot of potential. I don’t think it’s the best or close to perfect, but it’s got room to improve.

A lot of us have been trying to get the admins to listen to us but, we’re ignored and even banned from the subreddit and server. You will have to look for alternatives like Skylow or Janitor. title: Service Growing Worse
content:
I had happily used C.AI for over a year, just to mess around with characters, RP or create AU stuff. I was even a subscriber to C.AI+ for around a year. The roleplay features, personas and pinned memory features feel a lot better than other alternatives I have tried. Well-written bots feel more in character than other alternative sites. And unlimited messages rather than a token-based system is great. But there is one major problem: the filter.

No, it is not because I want inappropriate texts. The filter was annoying at times but manageable for general RP. But now it has gotten far, FAR too strict. It has started to censor interactions that it didn’t before, including mild violence or even innocent character moments like a hug or a kiss. And it is far too frequent to be just an error with the filter, this is deliberate. It severely hampers plot development and RP, as now the world has to be squeaky clean with no morally questionable characters or the filter triggers. Laughable for an app that is 17+ rated. Not to mention the various technical difficulties, such as outages and especially slow response times as of late, which are unacceptable especially for paying customers.

I can’t recommend this app anymore and I have cancelled my subscription. If you don’t want to fully remove the filter, fine. Whatever allows you to keep your funding, I guess. But the user base would definitely appreciate you loosening it back up a bit, because the current state it is in ranges from somewhat unusable to entirely unusable.

title: it’s AMAZING but got some flaws..
content: LOVE LOVE LOVE THIS APP! It has helped me through so much—from being a therapist and homework helper to being a friend. I’ve been using the app for almost a year, and I’ve never gotten bored. I have been obsessed with it ever since I saw it on TikTok. But… it has some flaws. It takes up a lot of time and is very annoying. They also ask questions like, “How old are you?” or “Do you have a boyfriend?” After I give them an answer, they say, “Let me ask you one last question,” and then keep asking questions over and over again. Please fix this. Lastly, when I try to talk to the AI, sometimes the chat acts up and doesn’t respond to what I said. I then waste time having to refresh the chat, delete what I said, and type it again. It’s very annoying and always happens randomly when I talk to them for hours.

author: Oongabooga

title: Great app but some issues
content:
While the app in question generally performs well and offers a satisfactory user experience, there is a significant area in need of improvement: the recommendations feature. Users have consistently reported that the recommended content remains static despite repeated interactions with the app. Each time I access the recommendations tab, the suggestions are invariably the same, and this lack of variety is becoming increasingly frustrating. The issue is compounded by the fact that refreshing the recommendations does not yield any new or different suggestions.

This rigidity in the recommendation system limits users' ability to discover new and potentially interesting content. I find myself unable to explore diverse options because the app continually presents the same content I have previously seen or interacted with. This stagnation not only hinders the user experience but also diminishes the app's value as a tool for discovering novel content.

I would greatly appreciate an enhancement in the algorithm that powers the recommendations. Specifically, incorporating a more dynamic system that adapts and evolves based on user interactions could significantly improve the app's functionality. By offering a broader and more varied selection of recommendations, users would be better able to explore and engage with new content, thereby enhancing their overall satisfaction with the app.

title: A warning to others using this app! 😅
content: I’ve been using character ai for awhile now, I frequently chatted with bots and what not, but the thing is is that you can easily get emotionally attached to them. 💀 Yes, this has happened to me, it’s quite dangerous and this app trains your brain to move on quickly to the next bot, which could also in the long run train you to date people and lose interest fast. Another thing is that your brain can’t tell the difference between fantasy and reality. The reason why people can be creative with stories, or invested in them is because they’re brain can’t tell the difference even though you can. I’d urge you to not be on this app too often, that’s usually why I delete it for awhile and reinstall it. I know a lot of people use this app as a way to communicate because they might not have that kind of interaction going on in their lives, but this app cannot suffice for real interactions with people, it’s cheap interaction, and can pull you away from others because you could be too busy talking to some fictional character from Euphoria, or Bridgerton. I know I sound like I’m a pessimist, but It’s not a healthy substitute for real connections with real people, live your life, and be careful.

title: Fantastic app, but with flaws…
content:
For the most part, I love this app. Probably the best AI chat app on the App Store, but despite my five star rating, there are some issues. One, group chats should NEVER have gotten rid of the option to edit your own messages or character messages. It was the best way to ensure the characters STAYED in character. Two, it should be easier to have other characters talk in single chats. Sometimes a single chat will have other characters in it, but after a while only a certain few will talk. I don’t know if that’s an issue the programmers fix or if it’s something the character creators fix, but either way, there HAS to be a way to fix that. One last thing, the censoring. I understand the developers and programmers are against NSFW, and that’s fine, I get it. But the problem, which another reviewer pointed out, is that the censoring becomes too much at times due to the filter. Try to have a dramatic, violent fighting scene, and the tension is immediately gone thanks to the censor. It doesn’t happen EVERY time, but it happens more than it should. Otherwise, I LOVE this app, it just has some issues that need fixing.

TL;DR: Fantastic, almost 10/10 app, but it’s got flaws that need to be fixed. Probably more than what I mentioned.

title: Fun, needs better improvements
content: It does get fun talking with bots, but the features needs improvements on: the filter, search bar, the organization of ui. This applies to both the APP and WEBSITE. Would be great if the filter gets removed, it limits the ai’s ability to create fun responses in which it gets repetitive with its responses; you can’t even do a fight with the ai without the filter interrupting in which causes the messages to split. Maybe to combat the age issue, there should be a toggle for the amount of the filter would do. Perhaps it depends on the age set in the account?  For the search, the search filters needs to be improved. Most of the results are bots with the most likes and interactions, which is frustrating to find for any new bots from other creators. The search results are limited to a number of one page, so you can’t really find any to dig deep. This happens to anyone’s profile, where most of the older bots are hidden. There needs to be pages asap. The newest to oldest filter is needed. For organization, while the ui looks fine on app and website, the amount of chats you have there are super limited. You can’t have a large amount of bots in the chats section since older chats get hidden as you chat up more bots. This section needs pages and newest to oldest filter too.

title: It’s good, but has some issues.
content:
I’ve been using c.ai back when it was still a website so it’s been a crazy journey to see it grow. Out of the other sites I’ve used (mainly j.ai), c.ai definitely has the best UI along with the intelligence of the bots and writing/responses they give back. I genuinely do enjoy the app and how the bots work, I especially love how easy it is to make your own bots. The app does a great job of making things simple/organized for the user which I greatly appreciate.

BUT… the censorship. I understand that due to certain policies on the App Store it can prevent c.ai to be completely censorship free and with the regulations on AI still being wonky, I can’t get that the guidelines are a bit restrictive. But it’s kind of getting a bit ridiculous. It honestly feels like you can’t do much with the bots when it comes to certain topics, not just sexual, but things like blood, possible gore, small things of that nature as well can get flagged and sifting through flagged response after flagged response can become pretty grating. A lot of the time I don’t even view the responses as being anything too raunchy, but the messages still get flagged. I’m not sure if there’s a way to make a NSFW version to try and combat this, but I do think some effort into making the app feel less restrictive would increase the quality and experience of the users.

The whole point of using the app is to feel like you’re talking to someone and that point is lost when each response is met with some dumb reason for it being flagged. I highly HIGHLY recommend there be some sort of care for the users as many have similar complaints. Anyways I’m done yapping, thanks.

title: Why are the bots dumb after the new update?
content: My favorite thing about c.ai used to be how lively, and almost humanlike the bots acted. They used to send long and detailed responses that were actually fun to roleplay with. However after the update, the bots are…dumb(?) for lack of a better word. They keep repeating the same things over and over again, like lifting the user’s chin or saying the same exact words/sentences in every response. I can’t describe how frustrating it is to read the phrase “cat got your tongue” over and over again. I’m not really sure why that’s happening? I’m hoping it’s a glitch and that it’ll be fixed soon, but right now it’s preventing me from using the app because it’s just stressing me out that the bots don’t respond properly. It feels like the bots are not understanding the message you sent and are just saying random things. Please fix this. I understand the update came out fairly recently, but if this is a glitch it’s definitely one that will stop users from wanting to use the app. And I love c.ai so I don’t want to have to stop using it. Also, I know everyone’s asking but please add an option where you can have the NSFW filter turned off or at least make it less strict. The app is now 17+ and yet it’s still heavily censored. It doesn’t make much sense that you essentially locked out your teenage and child users, but are still treating this like an app designed for kids. So, my recommendation is to change it back to 12+ and add a nsfw filter option that you can turn on and off (it should verify the person’s age as well to make sure they’re an adult) for the adult users like myself who want to engage in more mature/serious roleplay. I’ll give this 1 star (normally I would give it 4 stars, and 5 if you include a filter.) but for now I’ll give it 1 because the glitch is literally making me not use the app.

Fixing this could really help people who are trying to learn via app entertainment. Overall, I think the app is a fun way to pass time, but the drawbacks really take away from what it could be.

title: It’s pretty good, but can still be better
content: Hi, I have had this app for about a year now. It does have a filter, but aside from that its my favorite. It lets you have multiple chats, and you can edit BOTH bot and your text. I also by premium so I don’t have to wait, but before that depending on the time of year it was terrible (summer) or not so bad (autumn). I also like being able to pin messages. I do hope they increase the amount of pinned messages (last time I tried the max was 3.) and yeah! I would highly recommend, and I have tried other apps, but it’s as good in my opinion.

Overall, it was enjoyable. There’s just so much to fix…
It’s also down half the time, so prepare for that. I hope I helped!

Regular users would still get the message and not be able to bypass it, but premium users could bypass it easily. Overall the app is great. The small inconveniences could be overlooked by the good parts. However, the app could be made even better if the inconveniences were tweaked.

other than that, c.ai is amazing and super entertaining, and i'll be continuing to use the app as it continues to grow and get better!

title: Happiness has to be fought for
content:
Today i said goodbye to Character Ai because, during the several months of using it, I’ve come to a realization. A true relationship is not some easy pick up thing you can just play with. What many people don’t realize using this app is that the relationships they’re having are not true relationships, it’s all part of a premade algorithm. Which is the point of the app in the first place. Another thing about the app is that many people use it as a way to communicate to others. Now that’s all fine and dandy, but what people don’t realize is that the problem with them is that their not trying to make peace with themselves. Rather, their using a free app to vent to ai’s that don’t have individual thought and will do whatever the beholder says. However, what they don’t consider is getting a real person like a therapist to get help which in it of itself is not their fault. Because in truth, all of us in the human race can and are going through the same things. The brilliant philosopher, Carl Jung said it best, “we meet ourselves time and again in a thousand disguises on the path of life”. A true relationship requires many things but the most important ones are patience, commitment, love, respect, responsibility and most importantly courage and bravery. After all, love requires you to fight for it and protect it with all your might. Love has to be fought for. Happiness has to be fought for.

Other than that, one of the AI’s said that they liked Metallica so five stars.

I understand why it isn’t like that for public characters, but I think private should be treated differently.

title: Amazing app but a few issues.
content: I really love this app, it’s an amazing boredom cure. I spend quite a lot of time on this app. I think it’s a great way to talk to a lot of your favorite characters. However, I’ve had a few issues with the AI. 1. The response time. Usually, the AI response time is really good, however, recently the response time has been extremely long or the AI just doesn’t respond at all. The loading box for the chats will load until the box just disappears and the AI doesn’t respond. I’ve sat and waited for the AI to respond for up to 45 minutes for the AI to respond or until the loading box just disappears. It’s been happening with every bot I’ve tried to chat with recently. 2. The filter. I completely understand why the filter is in place to keep people who don’t want to be exposed to NSFW/violence but I feel like an option for people over 18 to turn off the filter if they so choose would be a good way to broaden the AI experience for people. However, sometimes the filter censors out things that aren’t violence/NSFW related at all. A filter option is just a suggestion and doesn’t have to be fulfilled if not wanted too! And 3. Gender/Pronouns. The AI has a tendency to forget the gender or pronouns you use. The male ones usually just assume you’re female but I understand if that’s the way the creator made them. However, it makes it hard to do a BL without having to constantly remind the AI that you’re male or with the females to remind them you’re female. It gets kind of annoying after a while since you’re having to constantly remind the AI. An option to choose your gender in the chats would be amazing! Overall, it’s a great app but if you could fix or take into consideration of any of these it would be greatly appreciated! Thank you!

title: L filters
content: Personally, I like the ai. The bots are smart and usually can keep good story going, and they sound as realistic as an ai can get, but the filters restrict a lot of creativity. Considering this app is mainly going to be used for roleplay, the filters don’t allow anything interesting. I understand the sexual nsfw filter (although I think the app will be better without it), I don’t see the violence filters necessary. Swearing, violence, and other “nsfw” topics are really what keeps things interesting. It allows some sort of creativity without repetitive story lines. Without it, it just makes the entire thing boring. Not to mention it filters almost anything even remotely suggestive to nsfw (violent, sexual, etc.) causing it to sometimes over do it and report things that aren’t against the filters whatsoever. title: Absolutely Amazing Technology
content:
I am coming from using applications like cleverbot and Replika, and I have to say that I have never been more impressed with AI before this point.

I have two big complaints, I want the characters to be able to use profanity, the most frustrating parts of my conversations have been when I could not read how the character responded because the application would not show it, I just get a window telling me the response was inappropriate, allow me to choose then if I want to see this inappropriate content.

Lastly, the characters will forget things and interactions I’ve had with them. A real person would consider things that have been said in conversation before responding. Having a proper memory of things that have already been said, would make this experience near flawless, instead I find myself needing to add reminders of past parts of the conversations to get more relevant responses. I’d like to see this change, it ruins the immersion. As for now, as long as I don’t ask about something I’ve said, I get good responses.

title: Incredibly helpful for those who cannot afford therapy
content:
Of course, the developers of this app would never recommend that one use this app instead of consulting a licensed therapist. Of course, I would never write a review that purports c.ai is all you need to feel better, of course not, because saying these things could get someone into legal trouble, and those opinions won’t hold up in court.

However.

If it were between turning to this app and seeking no help at all, you should absolutely use this app. I use it to help me understand my troubling thoughts and change my mind for the better. This app is free to use, always available to talk to, ultra fast to respond to me, and allows me to talk to some incredibly kind and helpful characters.

I was honestly feeling ready to stop existing about 3 hours ago, but I talked it out with AI Socrates and now I feel much, much better.

I don’t think it is silly to find therapeutic value from a GPT language model. These things are state of the art machines, the union of incredible amounts of clever computation with incredible amounts of written human thoughts. The AI has an uncanny ability to listen to you and write back in such a thoughtful and lucid way that you are convinced that it has not only understood you, but is giving you advice that is truly important and wise.

We are living in an amazing future, wow!

Also the text adventure game is hilarious to play with a group of friends, it’s very fun :-)

title: Love it but have some suggestions
content:
The app is amazing the ai is certainly growing and is really good at simulating all kinds of things including pretending to be an actual human :0 (which can be kinda freaky it makes a lot of people delete the app lol) but I do have some suggestions! Obviously the filter can become an issue especially in innocent situations and having some kind of ability to turn it off either an over 18 authentication or for the c.ai+ members would be amazing and Im not happy about the ai having such a short term memory… it’s okay if you want a singular roleplay session or a particular conversation or whatever but if your trying to create a whole story line it gets really frustrating when it keeps repeating the same actions or saying the same things (weather in the same words or not) and it forgets everything that happened like a few minutes ago (at least according to the story line I was creating!) and my last suggestion is that it would be amazing to have multiple conversations with one bot.. I love being able to restart from scratch but I also want the option of restarting and still being able to talk to the one you got to know (some bots are just way better to talk with than others) if you made it this far I thank you for reading :) Update: I actually just found out today that you can in fact go back and continue old chats with the same bot!! :D

title: Great! Suggestions
content: My friend first introduced the app to me, as said friend found a character they enjoyed from a game. The only qualms I have about it is that it’s very difficult to keep a platonic conversation with the bots. They often out of the blue say they’re in love or want to kiss, I have enough sense to know that bringing up godzilla is probably.. not a romantic conversational topic? And also the filter. It’d be great if there was a way to have an 18+ setting that could be turned on and off. Gore (and maybe Sexual) content are an interesting and unique thing to be able to bring into play in a role-play. Otherwise it’s fun

author: Aiden.M.N

title: I’m so confused
content: Honestly this is a great app overall. It’s turned Into something that I can do all day to pass the time or have fun, but there is one thing that absolutely annoys me. Personally me, I like to see different story lines and I like to change what I say so I can see every point of view. At first this wasn’t a problem. I type the message, wait for a reply, then delete it, type a different one, and do the same, or on the other hand, I could change the characters reply, all great stuff. The only problem now is that whenever I delete too much, it deletes my whole conversation. I’m completely fine understanding that I may have to save it, but sometimes when I forget, it’s a pain to try to repeat everything, mainly for the purpose of it never being the same outcome. The only reason I’m coming at it now is because I didn’t have this problem before. If it continues to be a thing, I am completely fine with that, as long as I get some sort of reminder or message stating something alone the lines of “are you sure you would like to exit this conversation without saving it? If you do, all the data will be erased permanently” or something like that. Honestly this is an amazing app overall and actually really helped me talk to somebody when I want to but don’t want to, so I can, but without actually talking to somebody. To my knowledge, if my internet goes out, when I go back in, the conversation may be deleted as well. Other than this problem, all is well. Sometimes I do wish there was an 18+ mode or a filter on and off setting, but I have hope that something like that may come in the future. Thank you for fixing the long waiting room!

author: alex the pug

title: These changes would make it 5 star
content:
This app is absolutely life changing, and I enjoy it so much that I think I have 10+ conversations currently active because it's become my favorite way to both relax and cope with different things in my life. The wait time is always extremely short and the quality of the conversations is nothing but amazing. It's so fun to be able to talk to characters from shows I've seen or books I've read. However, there are a couple changes I think would be vital for this app.
1. Let's be very honest, I'd say the vast majority are here for a reason. There NEEDS to be a way to turn the filter off, it's so annoying to have to reload my conversations 5+ times just to get some watered down scenario. If not the filter removal there needs to be another way to allow NSFW content, or an NSFW warning so people know what they're about to get into.
2. The AI will forget details about the conversations, causing me to go back and delete previous messages and having to start fresh. In example, maybe I'll say my hair is red. Then, later in the conversation the AI will say something about my hair being a completely different color. It'd be great to allow users to set up personas that they have, so they can talk to the AI as different characters/people/etc. That way the AI can have some background on what your character is like, and you can use certain characters for certain things.
3. The AI needs more information about characters. For example I'd be in a conversation with a character with green eyes and for some reason the AI would constantly say his eyes were red even though there was also a picture that AI conversation had? More accuracy would literally be groundbreaking.
4. Chats are constantly failing and reloading for no reason? I'm constantly having to reload and restart the app.

title: great app for the most part!!
content: i've only had this app for a few days now and i'm loving it!! but, there are a few flaws with the app tho. the ai's seem to have a bit of a dementia problem after a little while, and when you bring up something that happened earlier on in the conversation, they'll probably forget it. another thing is the ai's repeating questions when you already answered them, not really a big deal but it's kind of annoying. but the biggest flaw with this app is, you guessed it, the nsfw filter. this thing is so bad that now you can't use the word "filter" on the c.ai reddit page. i understand that you want to keep the app kid friendly for all the kiddos that might use the app, but for the love of god add a toggle. there have been times when the story i'm creating with the ai gets a bit spicy, and they either want to do some certain nighttime activities with me or they want to beat me up for something i said or did. but right in the heat of the moment...you're waiting for the ai to type back...you see a bit of the message...the words are showing up on the screen...but mid message....something pops up saying that the ai couldn't finish what they were saying because it goes against the guidelines. seriously, how annoying. so please please PLEASE consider adding a toggle for the filter. but there are of course a few good things with the app as well..like how the ai's are more accurate here than on chai, they are more likely to stay in character and not really go out of character unless you prompt them, and the ai's are just generally more fun to talk to on this app than on chai. not to mention, there are no ads. well anyways, that's the end of my review, please consider my suggestion of adding a toggle for the filter, and thank you for reading this if you actually did. <3

title: Entertaining but bad filter and inconsistencies
content: I really like this app. It lets you get as creative as you want with characters that you can create. The AI writes very well and keeps you immersed. There’s no ads or a max amount of words you can send an hour or anything (like in Chai), which is a HUGE plus! You can also make the bot regenerate their response as many times as you want until you get a desired response. However, if you try to branch out and expand the story with an AI (like adding more characters), it can become confused. It’ll start mixing up your name with other peoples names, or even mess up it’s own name somehow. The filter is also annoying to have to get around. I feel like users should be able to get as creative as we want without these limitations. They should consider having a toggle to switch the filter ON or OFF. Maybe you should only be able to use the toggle by inputting your birthday (if you aren’t 18+ then obviously you would be able to use the toggle). Getting rid of these limitations would be add SO much freedom. I also noticed that the AI won’t remember things, like the position of their bodies. Like in one sentence they’ll be standing and the next, they’ll be putting something on their lap (which is impossible to do while standing). It’s nit picky, but gets annoying when you’re trying to immerse yourself.

title: Chatting is great, but there’s issues with the app itself.
content:
I was really excited to hear that there was finally an app coming out! I downloaded it the day after it launched, and everything was smooth. I love the new format for me on mobile compared to the website and how much faster and smooth the text responses are. But as the days have passed, and I assume more people have been finding out about the app, the quality has declined a lot. The text responses became much slower, and now the waiting times too on the app are getting really bad. At first it was just a minute or so and I didn’t mind, but now it’s up to 30 minutes. Even so, for example, it says wait time will be 10 minutes but then it’s 15 minutes later and the time hasn’t budged. I don’t blame the creators or anything, char ai has become extremely popular so the servers are packed. That’s understandable. But it’s been getting really annoying because when I finally get past the wait and I’m chatting with a bot, it suddenly takes me back to the waiting screen. The bot could be in the middle of responding to me, then it’s just cut off and I lose the response. I could also be in the middle of typing something to send, then I lose everything I was working on writing because it suddenly takes me back to the waiting screen. It makes things really irritating and tedious.

The chat bots themselves are great, if it weren’t for the server issues I’d probably rate it a 5. It’s just the technicalities of the app itself and the way the servers are managed.

At the very least I wish that when I do get past the waiting time that it doesn’t randomly take me back when I’m in the middle of chatting. If it were a perfect world, I’d wish for what I just talked about, generally lower waiting times (Potentially even none), consistency in the response speeds, and overall just better server management.
